**graph:** An unresolved call to a name no symbol carries (a library function, a builtin) is recorded once per file and name instead of once per call site; a later save that defines the name reads those files again, so the update still links what a full build links, and `uses … callees` still counts each site. On this repository the non-Rust `unresolved_calls` rows drop from 21,887 to 11,714; graphs rebuild once.
